model.name: Interpersonal Relationship
model.purpose: Describe a dyadic interpersonal relationship through independent roles, validity and privacy-aware attributed perspectives.
model.scope_statement: A relationship between two referenced persons in a governed context, with independently qualified assertions and role episodes; not a global social graph or objective intimacy assessment.
in_scope: Scoped relationship identity, typed roles, direction and person references
Evidence, competing perspectives, role boundaries and episodes
Purpose-limited record access, correction and loss-aware projection
out_of_scope: Person identity masters, multiparty groups and households
Automatic outreach, social trust scoring or sensitive relationship inference
Legal status adjudication, consent grants and private-message ingestion

boundary_notes.distinction: Participants remain references; relationship is not a Person subtype despite registry parent navigation.
Contact detail and RelatedPerson serve different purposes; neither alone grants communication rights.
Role label is not sufficient evidence of mandate or legal rights.
Co-occurrence does not establish friendship or intimacy under this conservative profile.
Dyadic profile does not represent all multiparty social structures.

composition.purpose: Candidate participant reference, never Person inheritance or ownership.
Selected RELATED fields with loss annotations.
Limited patient-context mapping; not full RelatedPerson payload ownership.
Only appropriate knows semantics, never all relationships.
Assertion attribution, not truth or consent.

owner_package_requirements: Declare relationship-record steward and participants as distinct roles.
Identify authorized person, assertion and evidence masters.
Bind purpose, access, disclosure, correction and retention policies.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Opaque master-qualified relationship identity; person and assertion identifiers remain separate and never exposed merely through filenames.

canonicalization_rules: Preserve endpoint direction, vocabulary and independent author perspectives.
Keep effective episode times separate from observation and recording time.
patch_rules: Pin base version/digest; namespace role/profile extensions.
Append expected-head corrections with attributed reason, preserving permitted competing assertions.
compatibility_rules: Do not collapse types, inverse roles or episodes without explicit mapping.
Required privacy and perspective loss causes export refusal.

artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Use RFC 3339 seconds and explicit offset or Z for recording instants; preserve uncertain/date-only effective times separately.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Opaque relationship ID plus record-kind and revision; no private names or sensitive relation labels in paths.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Verify exact-byte digest and revision; integrity does not prove reciprocity or truth.

policies: Never infer intimacy, sensitive status or trust from surname, location, messages or a knows edge.
Attribution is not bilateral consent, truth or permission to contact.
Respect the other person and their data policies; owning a local record does not authorize unrestricted disclosure.
Do not collect private material merely to fill optional context.

read: Read owning Dimension policy, authorized scope, pinned spec and assurance before participant references.
create: Record an authorized attributed claim with endpoint ambiguity and unknowns explicit.
update: Append perspective or episode corrections under expected-head checks; do not silently resolve disagreement.
delete: Apply justified retention, erasure and legal-hold policy; keep only permitted minimal tombstones, not sensitive erased content.

roles.name: Dimension owner
responsibilities: Delegates local memory scope, not ownership of another person.

roles.name: Relationship steward
responsibilities: Maintains qualified relation and episode records.

roles.name: Reviewer
responsibilities: Checks perspective, direction and evidence limits.

access.default_rule: Deny absent field- and purpose-specific authority; even relationship existence may be restricted.
exceptions: Only explicit scoped time-limited disclosure exceptions with authorizer and rationale.
audit_requirements: Log authorized operation and opaque record/revision references without exposing sensitive content or credentials.

read_order: Attributed perspectives, role episodes and evidence
Validation, patching, record operations and safe retirement

coverage.claim: Bounded dyadic interpersonal relationship memory with attributed perspectives; not universal social truth, legal judgment or independent review.

checklist.notes: Scoped relation and separate endpoint identities.
Role vocabulary, direction and cultural label context.
Type, perspective and validity rather than physical measures.
Attributed statements and evidence without sensitive inference.
Persons, encounters and mandates are references.
Effective and recorded times kept distinct.
Claim authors and evidence scope retained.
Record stewardship does not own participants.
Executable nested schemas and privacy/reciprocity/round-trip fixtures not implemented.
Physical features belong to referenced persons or places.

known_omissions: Claude and Grok each timed out once; no independent external review.
Selected clauses only; RFC updates/errata, dated pins and licenses pending.
schema.org development version and ICO under-review guidance need stable profile verification.
RFC and ICO HEAD unavailable despite readable text.
No universal social/kinship taxonomy, multiparty profile or sensitive-inference mechanism.
No executable nested schemas, reciprocity/privacy fixtures or ratified composition adapters.
regional_assumptions: FHIR healthcare and ICO UK guidance are bounded examples; role meanings vary by vocabulary and culture.
adversarial_checks: knows is not endorsement or intimacy.
Social role is not a mandate or contact permission.
Shared context does not authorize sensitive inference.
Ending an episode does not end every tie.
Tombstones cannot disclose erased private details.
No private person records were accessed for this specification.
